schema: M36 coverage sweep: one record per runnable case; verdict CLEAN|SKIPS(n)|ERROR|TIMEOUT|CRASH as defined in sweep_coverage.py docstring; ranked_gaps counts cases_using (deck contains the unsupported family) and cases_blocking (family is a hard physics skip in that case's run). parse_error_signatures ranks the caught reader failures ('** ERROR while reading /X' — port parse bugs on real decks, distinct from clean unsupported-keyword skips and from rc!=0 crashes, of which there were none).
